message: いきなりでも大丈夫

name: Nanaka
message: 「Morning!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yaaawn...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You look sleepy again today. More repairs?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, yeah」
I can't exactly tell her it's because I'm doing special training to become the Demon Lord.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that apartment finally done for?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, why?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it needs repairs every single day like that, it's clearly on its last legs」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's really no big deal, seriously」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, I don't have anywhere else to live anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then why don't you just come stay at my place」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaat?!」
Living together with Nanaka!?

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you need extra hands, I can help out too--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Don't get the wrong idea or anything, okay. There's a limit to how much you can repair while still living there. T-There's totally no deeper meaning behind it at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I get it. Obviously」
R-Right. Nanaka doesn't feel that way. It's only because we're childhood friends.
I guess I've been way too self-conscious ever since that kiss...

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I mean, you know! I'm not saying you should sell it off or tear it down」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And I'm not saying you have to live at my place forever or, like, move in together or anything」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So it IS moving in together!? Wait, but that's, um」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, eh, ah, n-not like that, m-m-m-moving in together, what am I even saying! Scratch that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. I know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So it's just, you know, that. Like for a month, or a week, or three days or so, I just thought it'd be better if you thoroughly repaired your apartment during that time, that's all」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see」

name: Paqy
message: 「The way the number of days keeps dropping is pretty pathetic, man」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-S-Shut up!」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But, um, er, well, it's going to be fine!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-L-Like I said, even if you're ready to move in together, I'm not mentally prepared for that!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not what's fine! First of all, it's not broken at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm saying it's not broken」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But yesterday, and the day before that--」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, that was just a coincidence. A coincidence! Normally, even if a tank rammed right into it, it'd be fine!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now you're exaggerating, man」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Oh, I see. Well, if it's fine, then good. Sorry for jumping to conclusions!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm the one who's sorry for making you worry」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't worry about it, really! Maybe I've been meddling in your business too much just because we're childhood friends」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though we're just childhood friends」

name: Synn
message: 「Right... we're just childhood friends, aren't we...」
Yeah, that's right... even if we kissed, that's all we are.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right. Ahaha」
Isn't that obvious?
